findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not match its signature
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only definition in the parent UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user) which requires a user argument. Someone reading only this call cannot resolve it, and javac will fail with cannot find symbol. The re-authentication path in this file therefore does not compile.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys now require a known user, breaking usernameless login
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) returns true only when user != null, and authenticate at line 115 and challenge at line 137 now gate webauthnAuth.fillContextForm on that predicate. Previously the form was filled whenever passkeys were enabled, even with no user set, which is exactly what WebAuthn conditional UI / discoverable passkeys need on the initial login page. With this change an anonymous first-factor login gets no ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI attribute, no challenge, and no webauth form, so usernameless passkey login/autofill is lost while only the re-authentication case with context.getUser() != null keeps working.
